datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Somalia in 2016, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The data represents spatial projections of acute food insecurity conditions under different scenarios for February, June, and October 2016.
